description.en: The OSS bucket to which you want to export the image.

description.zh: 您的OSS Object的前缀。可以由数字或者字母组成，字符长度为1~30。
description.en: The prefix of the object as which you want to store the image in the OSS bucket. The prefix must be 1 to 30 characters in length and can contain digits and letters.
The name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens export-image --image-id m-5ragaz3s74b7go8ks7jp90000 --oss-bucket whxyl0000 --oss-region-id cn-beijing --oss-prefix dataCenter/9720000/ --role-name AliyunMNSLoggingRole --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens ExportImage --region cn-hangzhou --RoleName AliyunMNSLoggingRole --ImageId 'm-5ragaz3s74b7go8ks7jp90000' --OSSRegionId 'cn-beijing' --OSSBucket whxyl0000 --OSSPrefix 'dataCenter/9720000/'
